fixed.how: Root cause in the type data: every product spray of the group carries a printed label_text, cleaning's refill spray_bottle a blank one (''), and trigger_bottle none, so core read found no printed field on it. house_sim/data/types/mechanisms.json trigger_bottle now carries label_text '' -- the same read-tier printed field as every member, blank as on cleaning's plain refill bottle, no invented product label (a scene still writes one, e.g. label_text='GLASS CLEANER'); its doc says so. Core read answers a blank label {"label_text": ""} and nothing else (no read-tier field, no contents), so every unread member answers read in the same form (ok) in both camera modes, and the bottle stays an unidentified 'spray bottle of liquid' (realism._label_fields: a blank label identifies nothing; its liquid is never shown). The two plain members (spray_bottle, trigger_bottle) now read, read aloud and look alike afterwards too. Every member of the group already had a str label_text except this one, so cleaning.json needed no change. A moulded capacity / resin mark was considered and rejected: core read prints nothing beyond a blank label (cleaning's refill bottle would never show it), a mark on trigger_bottle alone would tell the two plain bottles apart, and a non-blank field would make reading it identify the bottle and its contents through _label_fields. Other readers of the field checked: rec.get('label_text') tests (cleaning, admin_inventory, climate, realism, people read_aloud) treat '' as no label as before; safety's chemical storage audit counts a blank label as 'unlabeled' (right for a decanted chemical; a plain trigger_bottle has no chemical tag or class) and safety._identify reads a thing with a label field before inspecting it (reference path only). No authored spec, furnisher or generated house places a trigger_bottle.
